current_checkpoint_note: Fertiliser Vertical -- End-to-End Real Workflow campaign, baseline 9458ef5 (Farm Awareness / Satellite Field Intelligence campaign closed clean, round 11). Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_PHASE0.md. Goal: connect FIELD/SOIL STATE -> NUTRIENT REQUIREMENT -> RECOMMENDATION -> PLAN -> GPS JOB -> CONFIRM ACTUAL -> REMAINING REQUIREMENT into one real, demonstrable, end-to-end loop -- not a fertiliser calculator sitting beside the rest of Farm Return. Decisive Phase 0/architecture finding ('no new Plan table'): a canonical planned fertiliser application is a real, accepted/edited fertiliser_recommendation Decision row -- no new persisted entity, no new migration. Lifecycle (Suggested -> Planned -> Active -> Completed-estimated -> Completed-actual -> Dismissed) is derived, never stored, from existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals state. New: src/domain/nutrients.ts gained knownFertiliserProductComposition (additive); src/domain/fertiliser-plan.ts (nutrientContributionFromFertiliserActual/sumConfirmedFertiliserApplications/calculateRemainingFertiliserRequirement -- Recommended/Planned/Actual kept distinct per campaign item 4; aggregateFarmFertiliserRecommendation/totalProductQuantityKgByProduct/aggregateFarmFertiliserDemand/toFarmInputDemand -- farm-wide demand, item 19/20); src/orchestration/prompt/fertiliser-recommendation.ts (promptForFertiliserRecommendation, the fifth real Prompt producer now fanned out per field by buildAllRealPrompts; validateFertiliserPlanEdits, a narrow plannedProduct/plannedQuantityKg/plannedDate allowlist -- 'Plan this application'); src/orchestration/fertiliser-plan/index.ts (getFieldRemainingFertiliserRequirement, getFarmFertiliserDemand -- real farm-scoped I/O over the pure domain arithmetic); src/orchestration/job-session/index.ts gained startJobSessionFromPlan (links a job session to an ALREADY-EXISTING accepted plan Decision, never inserting a second Decision -- origin 'plan' on job_sessions existed at the schema level before this campaign but is given real, distinct semantics here for the first time, narrowed apart from startJobSessionFromPrompt's own origin 'prompt'); src/app/actions/fertiliser-plan.ts (getMatchablePlanForFieldAction -- never auto-selects among multiple plans, item 11; startJobSessionFromPlanAction; getLinkedFertiliserPlanForJobSessionAction -- Confirm Actual prefill, item 12; getFieldFertiliserStatusAction -- real remaining requirement, item 14; getFarmFertiliserDemandAction -- item 19/20); src/components/farm/FertiliserPlanSheet.tsx ('Plan this application' UI, Nutrients screen, with a real spreading-window timing disclosure reusing promptForSpreadingWindow, item 7 -- never a new invented suitability score); src/components/farm/RemainingFertiliserRequirementCard.tsx (real remaining-requirement UI, Nutrients screen); GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx extended to look up a matchable plan before confirming and link to it when unambiguous (item 10); ConfirmActualSheet.tsx extended with an optional linkedPlan prop, prefilling product/quantity exactly once and never overwriting a farmer's own edit; ActiveJobSessionView.tsx wired to fetch the linked plan for a 'plan'-origin session; ai-context/index.ts's FarmContext gained a fertiliserDemand field (item 21) -- real farm-wide totals, no LLM reads it yet. Reuses (unmodified): calculateNutrientPlan, decideAsFarmer, submitPromptDecisionAction's own server-recompute discipline (extended, not replaced, to support fertiliser_recommendation + a validated edits allowlist), createJobSessionFromDecision (private, job-session/index.ts), listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm, listDecisionsForFarm, listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, computeFarmGrasslandAggregates (extracted from build-all.ts, not duplicated). No migration -- the entire canonical Plan/Actual/remaining-requirement loop is built on existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals tables. Deliberately NOT built this campaign (all documented in FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md): supplier marketplace/RFQ/purchasing (item 32), a new inventory subsystem (item 17 -- none real exists to connect), a new profitability engine or unverified fertiliser prices (item 18), silage-branch server-side recommendations (no real persisted SilagePlan exists), a farm-wide demand UI surface beyond the new server action/FarmContext exposure. Quality gate: 1904/1904 tests (145/145 files), up from 1790/1790 (139/139), +114 new tests. Codex audit round 1: 2 Critical + 6 High + 2 Medium found, 9 fixed + 1 rejected (verified not reachable) -- quality gate 1915/1915 (145/145) after fixes. Codex audit round 2: 0 Critical + 3 High + 2 Medium found (all real gaps in round 1's own fixes: farm-wide demand needed the same calendar-year boundary as field-level remaining; a plan already linked to a job session must not also still count as planned; a did_not_happen Actual must be excluded before any counting; FarmContext must not discard the truncated flag; Confirm Actual prefill needed an uncapped single-decision lookup, new getDecisionById) -- all 5 fixed, quality gate 1925/1925 (145/145) after fixes. Codex audit round 3: 0 Critical + 2 High + 0 Medium found (both real gaps in round 2's own fix: excluding an already-linked plan from planned used listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, which also matches a CANCELLED session -- a cancelled job produced no real Actual, so that fix made a genuinely still-outstanding plan vanish from both planned and confirmed permanently; fixed by excluding only via listActiveJobSessionsForFarm/confirmed sessions, never a cancelled one; the truncated flag now also reflects listActiveJobSessionsForFarm's own cap) -- both fixed, quality gate 1928/1928 (145/145) after fixes. A real, pre-existing, disclosed job_sessions schema limitation was found in the process (not introduced by this campaign): the database's own unique(decision_id) constraint means a plan can never be relinked to a second job session, cancelled or not -- documented under FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md's Known limitations, not fixed (outside this campaign's authority over the frozen GPS Job Mode contract). contracts_frozen remains false pending a clean round.

last_codex_audit.note: Round 3 of this campaign's own audit. Both real findings this round were a new gap introduced by round 2's own 'exclude an already-linked plan from planned' fix, not a pre-existing issue: that fix used listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, which returns a decision linked to ANY job session including a cancelled one -- a cancelled job produces no real Actual, so the plan behind it is genuinely still outstanding, and round 2's own fix made it vanish from both planned and confirmed permanently (compounded by a real, pre-existing, disclosed job_sessions schema limitation: the database's own unique(decision_id) constraint means that exact plan can never be linked to a second job session either, cancelled or not -- now documented under FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md's Known limitations, not fixed, outside this campaign's authority). Fixed: getFarmFertiliserDemand now excludes a plan from planned only when its Decision id appears in listActiveJobSessionsForFarm (genuinely in-flight) or the real confirmed-session read -- never a cancelled one; the truncated flag now also reflects listActiveJobSessionsForFarm's own real cap. Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md's own 'Codex audit round 3' section and IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md. Next: round 4.
